subject: Re: Request for DPA evidence and cross-border safeguards
messages:
From: Ellen Price <ellen.price@saasbank.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: SaaSBank Security <security@saasbank.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request for DPA evidence and cross-border safeguards

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking time on the call yesterday. As part of our vendor onboarding we need a compact evidence package to close our privacy review. Can you provide the following by EOD Friday?

- Answers to the attached DPIA/security questionnaire (Art. 28/30 focused)
- Snapshot of current subprocessors and their locations
- Description of lawful bases and international transfer safeguards (SCCs, BCRs, or equivalent)
- A redacted sample of the Art. 30 processing record for a representative customer workload

We attached our questionnaire (PDF). If anything needs legal review, please loop in your counsel. We prefer a single shared Drive folder with items and a DocuSign link for the DPA addendum once ready.

Ellen
Ellen Price
Security & Privacy Manager | SaaSBank
[attachment: saasbank_dpia_questions.pdf (PDF)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Price <ellen.price@saasbank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 14:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request for DPA evidence and cross-border safeguards

Ellen — thanks for the clear list. Monica (ops) and Laura (legal) are cc'd — I’ve started assembling the materials. Plan below:

1) Questionnaire: Monica and I will populate the attached spreadsheet with answers and references to policy docs.
2) Subprocessors: I will export the current subprocessor inventory and include region-tags; we will highlight non-EU processors and mitigation steps.
3) Transfers: Laura will confirm which transfer mechanisms apply; we typically rely on SCCs and contractual assurances for hosted API customers; we also provide options for EU-only deployments on Dedicated/Private where required.
4) Art. 30: We will produce a redacted CSV snapshot covering processing purpose, categories of data, retention, subprocessors, and storage locations.

Target delivery: consolidated Drive folder by Friday 2027-06-04 EOD. If that timeline is tight we can prioritize the questionnaire and transfers memo first.

Attachments: redwood_dpa_responses_20270603.xlsx (working draft)

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales, EU Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2027 08:23:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request for DPA evidence and cross-border safeguards

Karthik — I populated the technical sections in the draft spreadsheet and attached a processing-records export which we've redacted (internal ids replaced with placeholders). Notes:

- Subprocessor inventory: listed with region tags and SOC2 status. For the three non-EU subprocessors we note encryption-at-rest, contractual Data Processing Addendum, and monthly access reviews.
- Transfers: our standard approach for hosted customers is SCCs (we've applied the 2021 SCCs). For customers who require additional contractual guarantees or on-premises controls we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment options; include cost/ops note in the memorandum.
- Art. 30 snapshot: exported for a representative analytics workload (PII hashed; retention policy 90 days for session-level data). See processing-records-art30.csv attached.

I also flagged a question for legal on whether to include pseudonymisation detail in the redacted export — it might be safer to keep technical specifics high-level.

Attachments: processing-records-art30.csv

—Monica
Principal Operations Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2027 12:51:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request for DPA evidence and cross-border safeguards

Thanks both — reviewed. A few legal points before we publish the package:

- DPA addendum: I attached the proposed redwood_dpa-addendum-v3.pdf. It includes SCCs reference and standard audit rights language. We should not agree to unfettered onsite audits; suggest we offer remote evidence review and a scoped audit for material incidents.
- Art. 30: the CSV snapshot is fine if sufficiently redacted. Confirm we remove specific service keys and internal hostnames.
- Subprocessors: include vendor contact and SOC2 date; for any vendor without SOC2 we add compensating controls (encryption, contractual breach notification SLA).

Once you confirm edits, I can sign off and we can upload to the Drive folder and generate the DocuSign package for the DPA addendum.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Contracts | Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_dpa-addendum-v3.pdf (PDF)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Price <ellen.price@saasbank.com>, SaaSBank Security <security@saasbank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: DPA evidence package and transfer safeguards — Redwood response

Ellen — attaching the consolidated evidence folder and our proposed DPA addendum link. Summary and next steps below.

Summary of deliverables in shared Drive:
- Completed questionnaire (answers + references) — redwood_dpa_responses_20270603.xlsx
- Redacted Art. 30 export — processing-records-art30.csv
- Current subprocessor inventory (region + SOC2 date)
- Proposed DPA addendum (DocuSign link below)

Key points:
- Primary transfer mechanism: standard 2021 SCCs included in the DPA addendum; we can discuss BCRs where customers run on Dedicated/Private and require corporate-level solution.
- Audit rights: we propose remote evidence review and a scoped on-site audit option limited to security incidents or material contractual breach; full unfettered audits are not acceptable operationally.
- Deployment options: for strict EU-only processing we can offer EU Dedicated or Private deployments (cost and timeline noted in memo).

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/RDWDPA-2027-06-05
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cDPA-Shared-Responses
Attachments: redwood_dpa_responses_20270603.xlsx, processing-records-art30.csv, redwood_dpa-addendum-v3.pdf

Would you like a brief call Monday to walk through the DPA clauses and SCCs? Happy to schedule.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales, EU Accounts | Redwood Inference
